summary: Owned sets manage objectives, GitHub sources and GitHub scopes with declaration-only retirement

replay.detail: Owned-set receipt validation and replay accept native objective, github-source and github-scope members, including stopped declarations and omission retirement.

schema.detail: No persistent schema migration; existing desired declarations and owned-set receipts carry the additional member families.

rules.detail: Native roots use ordinary owned-set create, update, adoption and omission retirement. Retirement keeps historical claims and facts, does not change acquisition authority or fabricate fencing, and allows source-controlled reintroduction. Mission runs cannot stop these roots.

compatibility.detail: Publication requires every admitted fleet member to advertise features.owned_set_native_roots=1 when the set contains live or retired native roots; older daemons reject these receipts.

downtime.detail: Existing sets remain usable during the fleet upgrade.

manual.detail: Upgrade every admitted member before publishing native-root owned membership. Acquisition authority and transfers still require their existing explicit admission and fencing operations.

recovery.detail: Until the whole fleet advertises support, native-root set publication remains blocked without changing existing membership.
